implementation: Referenced-frame alpha classification is fixed before mesh construction; unreferenced frames are excluded.
Every uploaded frame refreshes one-pixel edge/corner gutters; transparent pixels erase prior borders.
Bounded animation metadata/timing plan rejects invalid frames/durations and unsupported interpolation.
Concurrent atlas adds share a promise; failed additions do not consume shelf space.
PNG header admission bounds input/pixel dimensions before asynchronous decoding; pending/retained decoded bitmap charges share 64 MiB per stack.
Failed decode/metadata requests evict promise state and release admission; disposal closes late decodes and rejects new work.
Resource-pack replacement pauses old atlas source uploads and ignores superseded asynchronous handoffs without altering voxel contents.

limits.bitmapAccounting: RGBA byte admission including pending decodes; excludes browser overhead and separate atlas canvas/GPU allocations

checks: Explicit animation timing, repeated frames, exact boundary and cycle wrap
All referenced frames classify alpha; unreferenced alpha excluded
Each upload includes copied one-pixel edges/corners and preserves neighboring atlas entries

Concurrent atlas adds deduplicate; failed allocation does not consume space; disposed atlas rejects delayed add
Bitmap header admission precedes decoding; owned pending decodes share the 64 MiB budget

Bitmap disposal is idempotent and closes delayed decodes exactly once
Renderer texture-source handoff pauses old uploads before bitmap disposal
